title: Five dated capacity and allocation boundaries
aggregationPolicy: Read cases independently. No total across cases, resource types, statuses, phases, parties or incompatible dates is supported.

cases.title: A public shortage statement is not a private customer queue
cases.claim: TSMC management described backend capacity as constrained and described coordinating wafer supply across CPU, GPU and other accelerator demand.

observations.boundary: Management-level backend capacity statement; no numerical package capacity denominator

limitations: No customer ordering, queue position, lead time, utilization or allocated wafer/package count is disclosed here.
Frontend wafers and backend packages have different process and unit boundaries.

triggers: Explicit correction or changed backend-status statement
recheck.supersedesScope: A new statement can supersede current-status interpretation; retain this dated event.
recheck.reviewRole: Technical editor with the source-domain reviewer when definitions or status change

cases.title: A queue contains proposals, not commissioned supply
cases.claim: The 2026 report counts roughly 8,200 active projects at end 2025, with 1,312 GW of generation and approximately 749 GW of storage requests.

observations.boundary: Generation requests within covered U.S. transmission queues
Storage power capacity in the same queue dataset; not GWh energy

limitations: Coverage represents about 98% of installed U.S. generating capacity; excludes load interconnection, distribution and behind-the-meter projects.
These requests are not operating data-center power or guaranteed future supply. Generation and storage nameplates are not equivalent firm energy.
doNotAggregateWith: Hybrid project count counted once per resource

recheck.supersedesScope: Use a new cutoff as a new snapshot; revised values for this cutoff supersede only matching observations.
recheck.reviewRole: Technical editor with the source-domain reviewer when definitions or status change

cases.title: An allocation grants a bounded resource entitlement
cases.claim: INCITE announced 75 projects for 2026 after receiving 143 proposals; one listed project received distinct Aurora and Polaris awards.

observations.boundary: Robert Hager project allocation on Aurora

limitations: Node-hours on different node architectures are not equal compute or energy.
Awards do not establish consumed time, queue waits, concurrent availability or scientific success.
doNotAggregateWith: Completed useful work or calendar-duration estimates

recheck.supersedesScope: Keep allocation years separate; a correction supersedes the named award, not all systems.
recheck.reviewRole: Technical editor with the source-domain reviewer when definitions or status change

cases.title: Contracted capacity and started service are different states
cases.claim: Core Scientific reported 395 MW billing for Q2 2026 and approximately 1.1 GW leased customer capacity in the release’s business update.

observations.boundary: Period-end customer capacity with service started and billing
Approximate reported business-update value; executed contracts whether or not service started

limitations: Do not subtract these observations as if they shared an exact cutoff.
Customer IT load is distinct from gross utility power agreements; billable is a subset status of leased capacity, not another inventory.
doNotAggregateWith: Gross utility agreements treated as IT load
Customer-side inventories of the same hosted sites

recheck.supersedesScope: Replace only matched definitions and cutoff; preserve reported-date differences.
recheck.reviewRole: Technical editor with the source-domain reviewer when definitions or status change

cases.title: One delivered phase sits inside a larger contracted plan
cases.claim: Galaxy reported delivery of Helios Phase I’s 133 MW critical IT in Q2 2026. The three-phase agreement covered 526 MW critical IT associated with about 800 MW gross power.

observations.boundary: Gross-power scope corresponding to three-phase lease
Phase II initial rent projected Q2 2027

limitations: Phase I is included in 526 MW; gross and IT describe the same development at different boundaries.
The 800/526 nameplate ratio is not measured PUE; future phase dates are not operating capacity.
doNotAggregateWith: Phase I plus all-phase contracted IT
A tenant inventory containing the same Helios lease

triggers: Phase commissioning, lease or energization revision
